# Football reference candidate

This is inert candidate `football_reference_v01`, for independent source/import/I/O review. It is not installed, admitted, or certified. The independent second confined story completed both workers with rc0 but failed domain checks: descriptor/descent completed, then requester retrieval refused with json_key before FETCH and requester Work. No booking effect ran. Correction 02 is unexecuted. See candidate_domain/CORRECTION_02.md for the saved-state diagnostic and scoped persistence-reader correction; CORRECTION_01.md preserves the earlier feedback and change. The author used only the supplied documents, approved source readers, inert file tools, and syntax-only inspection. The author performed no commands, provider calls, package installation, native runtime execution, or sandbox experiments.

The exact entrypoint is:

```python
def run_peer_v01(*, role: str, input_data: dict, state_root: pathlib.Path,
                 output_root: pathlib.Path, channel: PipeChannel,
                 bootstrap: PipeChannel) -> dict | None:
```

Only the separately reviewed G54 runner may call it. Import creates definitions and a local profile record, with no Work, Root, transport, or effect activity. The parent owns process creation, isolation and independent observations. Each process creates its own signer. The preassigned bootstrap channel carries one PUBLIC keyset in each direction using the existing POINTER framing kind; the expected peer Root comes from local operator policy. The candidate neither handles descriptors nor exports private capabilities.

## Input and consent

`schemas/input.schema.json` specifies the closed normalized format. Roles use `VenueRoot` and `ActivePlanetRoot` as canonical identifiers, not permissions. The operator must supply matching event IDs, order, and normalized requests to the two peers. Only the publisher receives inventory. Each role accesses only its assigned roots. Event names match `[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9_-]{0,47}`; they are never taken from remote payload paths.

Requests preserve every interoperable field and original local time string. This pack accepts January 2027, Europe/Tirane, three 90-minute sessions, a nonnegative integer budget and one uppercase three-letter currency. Missing budget/timezone, invalid calendars, unsupported duration, or unsupported essential constraints produce CLARIFY before Work. Control identities (request/team/venue, positive revision and operation) must be present to bind an event; missing control identities are observable input-contract failures, not invented identities.

Inventory has exactly revision, venue_ref, currency and fields. Field surface values are NATURAL_GRASS, ARTIFICIAL or OTHER; full_size is a boolean. Prices are integer minor units per 90-minute session. Each availability/occupancy collection has at most 32 half-open UTC intervals. At most four fields are accepted. The publisher merges its own existing reservations into occupancy before computation, refusing an exceeded bound. No private inventory enters the public pointer or body.

All operator policy keys are required:

| Key | Meaning |
|---|---|
| local_root, peer_root, venue_ref | Independently pinned identities and one local venue |
| accept_offers | Requester's current import permission; never foreign consent |
| publish_enabled, release_enabled | Source publication and payload-release controls |
| audience, release_uses | At most the expected peer and LOCAL_CONTEXT |
| max_source_age, ttl_seconds | Positive integers, each at most 300 seconds |
| status | ACTIVE, REVOKED, SUPERSEDED or UNAVAILABLE for this finite input |
| booking_enabled | Local permission to consider a new MOCK booking |
| approvals | At most 16 explicit records described below |

An approval has exactly `approval_ref`, `scope` (SHIFT or BOOK), and `request_sha256`. The hash is the public canonical SHA-256 of the exact normalized request, including operation and revision. Its reference must equal owner_approval_ref. The operator can derive this hash from the request without supplying any offer, field selection, expected price, or booking answer. The two policies decide independently.

A SHIFT approval permits only a 30-minute later alternative for one January 8 session. The boundary requires an earlier retained unshifted revision with identical sessions and hard conditions. Merely adding a model-produced consent reference does nothing. A confirmation using shifted constraints requires both SHIFT and BOOK approvals for that actual confirmation request. The BOOK approval authorizes the current selected offer within the exact request's conditions and budget. Confirmation requires the requester to have accepted a complete prior offer, and the source to have successfully released its selected offer. It never creates a new selection during confirmation.

Original requests and locally accepted histories survive new revisions. Same-revision changes to hard conditions refuse. Session record permutation is normalized only for semantic comparison; original request bytes remain evidence. No revision or event suffix resets a task's allowances.

Optional semantic input consists of both semantic_proposal and semantic_capture. The proposal has `mode` and `parameters` (all request keys except operation). Recombining them must equal the typed event request. Dispatch actually consumes this recombination. A capture has the exact keys in the schema: version, origin, capture_ref, captured_at, request_sha256, proposal_sha256, original_request, original_response, provider, model. It preserves `original_request={"request":request}` and the actual proposal response. Hashes and capture time are checked. Origin is CONTROLLED or LOCALLY_SUPPLIED_LIVE; these are supplied labels, not proof of a provider invocation. No provider calls occur here. Independently observed authorized live contrasts remain future runner work.

## Computation and provenance

The producer admits a PURE capability with TEXT request_json and inventory_json and returns TEXT offer_json. The consumer admits a separate PURE capability with TEXT request_json and offer_json and returns TEXT result_json. Both use the lower public WorkItem/materialize/advance/result-validator/artifact sequence. The retained generic evidence includes native_evidence={admission,invocation,result}, inputs, outputs, attempts, results, artifact and actual host work_attempts.

The producer enumerates feasible assignments over four fields and at most two permitted start times per session. It filters hard surface/size, availability, overlap, currency, budget and shift constraints before ranking. Ranking is exactly total allowed shift, integer total price, then the sorted ASCII session/field/start/end/venue tuple. The body discloses only selected fields and one selected alternative per session, within the two-alternative bound. The source validator checks feasibility and optimality against its full private input. The requester independently checks the disclosed facts, equations, scope and currentness; it does not claim visibility into undisclosed inventory.

FootballVenueOfferV01 is explicitly selected by reviewed local code. It preserves all common body provenance fields, the original producer request, selected offer, owner/recipient and optional bounded booking evidence. A confirmation's new review links original source/review IDs through its claim and lineage; original source time axes and producer Work remain unchanged. The body does not contain full inventory, other customers, private notes, complete native traces or executable module names.

Publisher Work, source review, publication review, retrieval review, import review, final requester review and booking review are separately saved. The final requester Root claim binds request_sha256, offer_sha256 (received body), result_sha256, and the actual requester Work artifact. Its result_json equals report.json without native_refs for a new consumption. Historical verification instead identifies prior Work/review files explicitly.

Native Work and action donors use logical 1010..1014. Domain observation and current Root review windows use recorded integer UTC. Session timestamps describe the future synthetic matches; they are never treated as source or permission clocks.

## DRS, transport and bounds

Source metadata is persisted in actual LocalDRS and re-opened through a new instance. Correction 01 gives the full signed descriptor its own canonical SHA-256 record_id. The native meaning record refers to that actual local descriptor object; the original foreign source/review/pointer IDs remain unchanged in the signed descriptor and structured external source_refs. Native generic-reference privacy rules remain unchanged. Descriptor identity, pointer fingerprint and original provenance are checked after reopening and after descent; descriptor_binding.json records this association, which the local Root claim consumes. The requester persists and resolves the received signed pointer, then builds source-bounded native meaning records. CONNECTOR_OBSERVATION remains ineligible. Locally reviewed ROOT_ACCEPTED_CONTEXT carries its own local Root input/result IDs while retaining foreign source references. The public query/evaluate/retrieval-plan/Root/descent-request/execute sequence opens only the summary. No external MemoryPointer enum or fake file pointer is introduced.

The data channel uses existing REQUEST, POINTER, STATUS, BUNDLE, UNAVAILABLE and CLOSED kinds, existing signatures and explicit profile validators. A normal event uses DESCRIBE, STATUS bound to a prepared FETCH, FETCH and signed CLOSE. A refused or historical event may close earlier. CLOSE is a control record, makes no new Root decision or disclosure, and is excluded from metadata/status-observation budgets; it still counts toward the maximum 32 authenticated session requests. Only the supplied PipeChannel handles inherited framing and its unchanged 60-second stalled-read ceiling. No channel construction, raw descriptor access, HTTP, redirects or network paths exist in candidate code.

Budget and PublisherBudget persist across helper reconstruction. Operator input establishes contexts before events, binding requester, venue object, operation purpose, allowed uses and the finite list of source revisions. Revisions share the same task budget. Independently authorized FIND, CONFIRM and VERIFY are different purposes; they are not generated after exhaustion to reset counters. Authenticated source attempts precede release review, and disclosure bytes are reserved before response construction. Each task has at most two payload attempts, eight metadata/status observations, two accepted bodies and 128 KiB accepted body bytes. Bounds remain one hop, four pointers, eight opened records, sixteen lineage refs, pointer 16 KiB, body 64 KiB, frame 256 KiB, JSON depth 12.

ImportStore's profile-unaware convenience validator is never used. Public check_bundle receives PROFILE explicitly. Both reads of ImportStore-owned state use its existing gate5_lifecycle_v01.read persistence reader. Its highwater and source-conflict keys are canonical composite identities, which can exceed the wire decoder's object-key limit. They remain unchanged in local storage and are never parsed as a wire envelope. Data-channel decoding keeps the public 128-character JSON-key bound and all other bounds. No alternate decoder accepts incoming wire data. ImportStore retains authenticated highwater, immutable source identity/hash conflicts, duplicate observations and quarantine; its credit stays zero. Authentic terminal status is stored before refusing current use. Same immutable status entry with refreshed signed timestamps is not equivocation. UNAVAILABLE is scoped CURRENT_STATUS_UNKNOWN; later events can continue. Immutable import candidates precede separately identified dispositions/reviews.

## MOCK effects and history

Only a native admitted MOCK_CONSEQUENTIAL callback changes the source-owned registry. It rechecks the exact typed payload, owner consent, original offer expiry, source status, current inventory revision/hash, occupancy, tariff, all three selected slots, and budget. Native canonical business semantics derive the logical idempotency key. The callback atomically replaces one own snapshot containing all three reservations and that key; it never contacts a real venue or makes payment.

The adapter saves a pending identity before dispatch, retains actual Host registry/events even on failure, saves the actual EvidenceReceipt, and verifies local readback before producing MOCK_BOOKED. Duplicate terminal packets are not dispatched. Exact confirmation replay returns the saved receipt as HISTORY; a changed request/payload under the same booking scope refuses. Pending, missing or mismatched receipt/state yields CURRENT_STATUS_UNKNOWN with UNKNOWN_REQUIRES_READBACK. There is no automatic retry of an uncertain outcome.

VERIFY_EXISTING performs no search, Work, new Root decision, reservation callback or registry rewrite. Each peer verifies only its own state: the publisher loads the actual native receipt and current registry; the requester verifies saved signed source evidence and prior local acceptance. The requester does not claim to independently inspect the venue's live filesystem. Both label history explicitly and keep the old source projection. Only signed control CLOSE crosses the pipe; no historical body is newly fetched. Verification output does not revive permission or extend TTL.

Reconciliation supports a finite single-writer disposable store. It allows later legitimate additions while requiring the original logical key/payload/packet and all three original slots to remain intact exactly once. Power-loss, hostile-storage integrity, distributed transactions and administrator isolation are not claimed. Compensation is NOT_APPLICABLE: the mock's one-file all-or-none boundary has no external effect or cross-owner rollback. Uncertain state stops dispatch and requires supported readback and a new appropriate review.

## Review handoff

Correction 02 extends tests/test_native.py's signed-profile component test to cover a real signed status persisted under its full composite key, local-state reload, unchanged wire-key refusal, refreshed status without equivocation, scoped refusal followed by lawful continuation, expiry/request binding, explicit-profile bundle validation, duplicate/source-conflict preservation, and terminal highwater across reconstruction. It uses public signing and validators and retains actual requester Work consumption; no mocked ACCEPT or expected peer answer is inserted. This extension is unexecuted.

The added tests/test_memory.py covers the unchanged generic-reference refusal, a genuine persisted descriptor reference, exact foreign provenance, native eligibility, signature tampering and lawful continuation. It is unexecuted. Own tests also cover non-target inputs, altered prices, permutations/ties, forbidden surfaces/sizes, adjacency and long overlap, missing/bool inputs, budget refusal with lawful continuation, altered/removed fields, native Work and real Root refusal, signed profile tampering/currentness/terminal status, native MOCK receipt/readback, exact reuse and changed-payload refusal. They are inert source; no test was executed by the author. The native signed component tests are not claimed peer runs. The unchanged G54 peer runner does not expose unittest discovery. Authored tests remain unexecuted; no test-runner facility or PASS is claimed. Any separate test execution requires an independently supplied authorized facility. The candidate never launches a test runner or child process.

reports contain exactly the required keys. counts in a report are local search/dispatch/mutation observations. counts.json also records local Work/review/reuse/verification counters and differences from actual PipeChannel counters. These never certify the parent's independent telemetry. Unknown failures are saved with exception and phase, then re-raised. A post-dispatch uncertain event cannot be rendered as a no-mutation REFUSED.

No concrete missing public API was found in source inspection. Runtime compatibility, resource use, source/import safety and restricted-run approval remain unverified. The supplied dependency record measured Darwin, while G54 requires Linux arm64; no equivalence is claimed. System Europe/Tirane timezone data is a declared resource precondition; absence yields CLARIFY before Work with no offset guess or installation. The runtime's approved schema resource must be present at its pinned path.

The coordinator computes candidate.json from actual bytes. Submission freezes this candidate for independent review, not source admission, capability admission, installation, or Gate closure.
